SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Ask whether Lake Mamry is the planned water for your date or one option within a mobile guiding area. Match accommodation to the confirmed launch, not just the region. Select lure sizes and rod power after the operator narrows the main target and confirms supplied equipment.

Choose the access before the outfit

Lake fishing can mean a bank session, trolling, jigging or a guided casting day. Confirm which of those is actually offered. Check boat and equipment provision before buying a second setup, and keep the personal day bag distinct from shared tackle.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Poland

Foreign visitors who stay temporarily in Poland are exempt from the inland angler's card. They still need the permit for the chosen water; the exemption does not provide free access.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • PZW Suwalki Mamry water permit ↗
    Visiting anglers on this water Buy a short-term permit online or from PZW Suwalki sales points.

Rules for this water

  • Mamry and Swiecajty form one permit water; confirm coverage before moving to adjoining lakes.
  • Use no more than 1 kg of groundbait per angler per day.

Full Poland licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
